{
  "decision-measure-reclaimable-folder-bytes": "WITH folder_objects AS (
  SELECT folder_code, object_id, COUNT(*) AS name_count
  FROM directory_entry
  GROUP BY folder_code, object_id
), ownership AS (
  SELECT folder_code, object_id, name_count, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY object_id) AS folder_count
  FROM folder_objects
)
SELECT f.folder_code, COALESCE(SUM(e.name_count), 0) AS names_removed,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.folder_count = 1 THEN o.byte_count ELSE 0 END) AS bytes_reclaimed
FROM folder_list AS f
LEFT JOIN ownership AS e ON e.folder_code = f.folder_code
LEFT JOIN stored_object AS o ON o.object_id = e.object_id
GROUP BY f.folder_code
ORDER BY f.folder_code COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-measure-warranty-top-up-after-prior-service": "WITH units AS (
  SELECT unit_code, serial_no,
         SUM(CASE WHEN line_state = 'paid' THEN cost_cents ELSE 0 END) AS paid,
         SUM(CASE WHEN line_state = 'pending' THEN cost_cents ELSE 0 END) AS pending
  FROM service_line
  GROUP BY unit_code, serial_no
  HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN line_state = 'pending' THEN 1 END) > 0
), ranked AS (
  SELECT u.*, c.cap_cents, c.source_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.unit_code ORDER BY c.card_rank DESC) AS precedence
  FROM units AS u
  JOIN card_evidence AS c ON u.serial_no BETWEEN c.serial_low AND c.serial_high
)
SELECT unit_code, MIN(pending, MAX(0, cap_cents - paid)) AS provision_cents, source_id
FROM ranked
WHERE precedence = 1
ORDER BY unit_code",
  "decision-merge-sparse-asset-corrections-at-cutoff": "WITH final_values AS (
  SELECT s.asset_code, s.bin_code AS old_bin, s.finish_code AS old_finish,
         CASE WHEN b.slip_no IS NULL THEN s.bin_code ELSE NULLIF(b.bin_code, '') END AS final_bin,
         CASE WHEN f.slip_no IS NULL THEN s.finish_code ELSE NULLIF(f.finish_code, '') END AS final_finish,
         b.slip_no AS bin_id, f.slip_no AS finish_id
  FROM catalog_snapshot AS s
  LEFT JOIN correction_slip AS b ON b.slip_no = (
    SELECT slip_no FROM correction_slip
    WHERE asset_code = s.asset_code AND effective_day <= 20 AND bin_code IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY effective_day DESC, slip_no DESC LIMIT 1
  )
  LEFT JOIN correction_slip AS f ON f.slip_no = (
    SELECT slip_no FROM correction_slip
    WHERE asset_code = s.asset_code AND effective_day <= 20 AND finish_code IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY effective_day DESC, slip_no DESC LIMIT 1
  )
)
SELECT asset_code, final_bin AS bin_code, final_finish AS finish_code,
       CASE WHEN final_bin IS NOT old_bin THEN bin_id END AS bin_slip_no,
       CASE WHEN final_finish IS NOT old_finish THEN finish_id END AS finish_slip_no
FROM final_values
WHERE final_bin IS NOT old_bin OR final_finish IS NOT old_finish
ORDER BY asset_code COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-meter-reset-production-depreciation": "WITH production AS (
  SELECT line_code, SUM(end_read - start_read) AS units, GROUP_CONCAT(slip_id, ',') AS source_ids
  FROM (
    SELECT line_code, slip_id, start_read, end_read
    FROM meter_slip
    WHERE approved = 1
    ORDER BY line_code COLLATE BINARY, slip_id COLLATE BINARY
  )
  GROUP BY line_code
)
SELECT l.line_code, COALESCE(p.units, 0) AS produced_units,
       MIN(COALESCE(p.units, 0) * l.unit_rate, l.cost_cents - l.residual_cents - l.opening_dep) AS charge_cents,
       p.source_ids
FROM line_basis AS l
LEFT JOIN production AS p ON p.line_code = l.line_code
ORDER BY l.line_code COLLATE BINARY"
}
